scope: Demons Among Us -> Keep Your Friends Close visibility; warlock pet regeneration, Health Funnel, Drain Soul/Drain Life, Soul Leech, Demon Skin and Soul Link.

quest.result: Combat phase 7422 ending is expected. Elthyn has normal mask 1 and no exclusive phase IDs; he remains visible in the Orgrimmar plateau camp. No quest/character mutation.

findings.before: Fixed 24 HP at Rate.Health=1, per pet regeneration tick.
findings.after: 1.5% maximum HP times Rate.Health; pets use the existing 2000ms interval. Existing combat/evade and RegenHealth guards are unchanged.

findings.before: Heal used 8% of pet maximum HP while sacrifice used 4% of caster maximum HP.
findings.after: Both use caster maximum HP: base 4% sacrifice, 8% pet healing per tick, six ticks. Existing stop-at-full-pet behavior retained.

findings.result: Native periodic leech multiplier 2 / 6 respectively, healing the caster only. Core HandlePeriodicHealthLeechAuraTick already targets caster. Affliction gets 198590; Demonology/Destruction get 234153. No invented direct pet heal added.

findings.before: Pet cumulative/capped value was calculated but not used; delayed snapshots could overwrite simultaneous contributions. AoE check inspected passive driver instead of damage spell.
findings.after: Accumulate against current shield, cap separately by each recipient maximum HP, exclude area damage. Pet/minion damage shields the owner and primary pet. Modifiers apply to contribution, not repeatedly to stored shield.

findings.before: Pet recharge used owner maximum HP; initial shield cast bypassed cap.
findings.after: Each recipient recharges 1% of own maximum HP per native 1000ms tick, capped at 20%; same shield update helper as damage procs.

findings.before: Script healed on incoming split damage, contrary to native description.
findings.after: Demonology-only native ability heals owner/pet for 25%/50% of new absorption granted by Soul Leech, including Demon Skin; old split-damage script removed. Requires a living primary pet and active 108446 owner aura.
findings.boundary_interpretation: Healing is based on actual shield increase after cap; a full shield grants no new absorption. This follows the native wording but independent retail combat-log confirmation of capped/unequal-shield edge cases is still outstanding.
